subject.title: feat(ui): gateway subtitle in the sidebar footer identity card

question: Should the Mac app add this persistent multi-gateway identity cue in the sidebar footer based on mock-backed UI proof, or should a real native-app demonstration be required before acceptance?
rationale: This is a new user-visible Mac workflow detail, and the PR body asserts an owner directive without an independently reviewable maintainer decision in the supplied discussion context.

options.title: Require native-app proof before landing
options.body: Ask for a redacted Mac app capture with two gateways and a gateway-change update, then merge if the exact head is otherwise approved.

options.title: Accept mocked UI proof
options.body: Sponsor the presentation change based on the established bridge and existing focused UI coverage, accepting that host integration is proven by the earlier merged feature.

options.title: Defer the footer enhancement
options.body: Keep the existing header picker as the gateway identity surface and close or pause this optional presentation addition.

recommendation.title: Require native-app proof before landing
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted Mac app capture with two gateways and a gateway-change update, then merge if the exact head is otherwise approved.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged multi-gateway bridge and this proposed footer extension share the same recent feature history.
